title: A Look Inside Apple's $130 USB-C Cable
summary: Adam Savage and engineer Zach Radding examine Lumafield CT scans of Apple's $130 Thunderbolt 4 cable alongside cheaper USB-C cables. They explain the internal components that distinguish Thunderbolt from ordinary USB-C.
why: Linked whenever people ask why a Thunderbolt cable costs so much; the CT scans show the construction difference clearly.

quote.text: if you're interested in why the Thunderbolt cable costs more than charging cables, some folks put one through a CT scanner recently
